title: Palm: A Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse Dataset for Arabic LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces the PALM dataset which specifically includes 'Religion' as one of its 20 core topical domains for evaluation. This domain is defined as exploring major monotheistic religions and religious figures. Additionally, the paper discusses religious cultural bias (e.g., suggestions for 'beer after prayer') and aims to benchmark and improve LLM performance on these culturally and religiously sensitive topics.
